method: Current-run screenshots inspected by Codex and a read-only subagent; functional claims come from actual browser receipts, not stills alone.
finding: Normal field guide displays measured geometry and selected building; unavailable cases visibly warn while sampled stop controls remain. Finale figures and return, programme completion visible. At320 header is substantial; physical ergonomics not tested.
limits: Headless/emulated browsers and synthetic fault/data; no physical-phone, OS-picker, screen-reader or human acceptance.
